summary: Implemented canonical inquiry event ledger with append-only transitions, SHA-256 cryptographic hash chaining, idempotent replay deduplication, and strict zero-PII enforcement across rbpc_content_audit.

ledger_append_only.behavior: Each lifecycle state mutation writes an append-only row to rbpc_content_audit recording timestamp, actor_id, entity_type='inquiry', entity_id, previous_hash, new_hash, and non-PII diff_payload.

cryptographic_hash_chain.genesis_rule: First entry per entity has previous_hash = None
cryptographic_hash_chain.chain_rule: Each subsequent entry's previous_hash matches exactly the preceding entry's new_hash
cryptographic_hash_chain.tamper_detection: Any modification of stored diff_payload or hash breaks chain continuity and is flagged as tampered content

replay_deduplication.api_layer: In update_partner_inquiry_status, if inquiry is already at target_state, returns HTTP 200 OK cleanly without writing duplicate audit entry
replay_deduplication.service_layer: In record_inquiry_state_transition, if target state matches current audit head or old_state == new_state, returns existing latest audit record without inserting duplicates
replay_deduplication.post_creation_replay: POST /api/v1/rbpc/inquiries with identical idempotency_key returns original receipt HTTP 202 without writing duplicate inquiry_created audit entry

zero_pii_invariant.free_text_redaction: Emails replaced with [EMAIL_REDACTED] and phone numbers replaced with [PHONE_REDACTED] in all audit diff values

risks.mitigation: Chain verification is scoped per entity_id (typically 3-5 entries per inquiry lifecycle) with indexed lookups on (entity_type, entity_id).
Idempotent return at API layer plus fallback deduplication at service layer guarantees zero duplicate entries even if concurrent PATCH requests arrive.
